name: GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3 (TensorFold, TP=2)

memory_estimate_mb.notes: MiaAI README (pin 02dac3879852): per Spark on the served pair, model 83.3 GiB, KV pool 12.5 GiB, prompt cache 3.6 GiB, MEMORY_RESERVE_GIB=9.5. Not measured by herd.

drafter.notes: Upstream: for commercial use set DRAFTER=mtp or none. Herd does not bypass that term.

flags.notes: Serving knobs (PARALLEL, KV, DENSE, etc.) live in the pinned upstream start.sh / scripts/config.sh. This file does not invent launch flags.

ports.notes: Upstream default PORT=8020 (API on rank 0). local.sh on a served pair may set 8888 — treat as host overlay, not a silent rewrite.

multi_spark.rule: Requires a configured two-Spark group. Binds the group's existing head/worker membership and interconnect. Does not change RoCE hardware.

notes: Apache-2.0 upstream recipe — herd does not copy its scripts. Dashboard invokes the pinned entry points only.
DRY_RUN=1 ./start.sh prints the plan including the link it finds.
./start.sh checks both Sparks, builds the image, places weights, starts rank 1 then rank 0.
Upstream performance tables are citations, not herd SLAs.
ConnectX-7 cabling and IPv4 on one subnet are prerequisites to validate, never to configure silently.
Preview uses DRY_RUN=1; confirm runs ./start.sh from the pinned checkout. WORKER must already be set in the group's overlay.

worker.note: Checkout + readiness + stop on the worker agent. Head ./start.sh starts both ranks using already-configured WORKER; this agent is not skipped.

head.note: Pinned ./start.sh (DRY_RUN=1 in preview). WORKER must already be configured; herd does not rewrite RoCE.

source.repoLicenseNote: Do not copy Apache-2.0 recipe/engine patches into herd. TensorFold itself is Apache-2.0 (from 0.6.0).
source.modelLicenseNote: Checkpoint and drafter licenses are separate; drafter default is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.

description: TP=2 GLM-5.3-Flash on two DGX Sparks via the pinned MiaAI TensorFold recipe entry points. Herd wraps ./start.sh and ./stop.sh; it does not vendor upstream scripts or claim TensorFold metrics support (unverified adapter).
